title: Senate court junks Cayetano bid to stop conviction threshold voting
summary: Voting 13-6-1, the Senate impeachment court rejects the point of order raised by Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano. The rejection means the court may proceed to act on the threshold issue.

blocks.text: IMPEACHMENT TRIAL. The Senate impeachment court in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.
Senate of the Philippines Facebook page
Voting 13-6-1, the Senate impeachment court rejects the point of order raised by Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano. The rejection means the court may proceed to act on the threshold issue.

MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court on Wednesday, September 23, rejected a bid to prevent the court from interpreting the voting threshold for convicting Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial.

With 13 affirmative votes, six negative, and one abstention, senator-judges trashed the point of order raised by Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano, who argued that the court has no authority to interpret the voting threshold.
